def transform(grid):
    # A uniform separator splits the two aligned panels; the shared panel color
    # is the default, and an aligned shared-color pair is marked with 3.
    sep=next(i for i in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[i]==grid[0][i] for row in grid))
    left=[row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right=[row[sep+1:] for row in grid]
    colors=set(sum(left,[])) & set(sum(right,[]))
    common=next(iter(colors))
    return [[3 if a==common and b==common else common for a,b in zip(l,r)] for l,r in zip(left,right)]
print(transform(test))

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    if w%2==1 and all(row[w//2]==grid[0][w//2] for row in grid):
        left=[row[:w//2] for row in grid]
        right=[row[w//2+1:] for row in grid]
    elif h%2==1 and all(value==grid[h//2][0] for value in grid[h//2]):
        left=grid[:h//2]
        right=grid[h//2+1:]
    else:
        raise ValueError('No central separator')
    colors=set(v for row in left for v in row) & set(v for row in right for v in row)
    common=next(iter(colors))
    return [[3 if a==common and b==common else common for a,b in zip(l,r)] for l,r in zip(left,right)]
